lead: Enquiries come in by WhatsApp, Facebook, email, phone and your website. Some get answered, some get forgotten. We put them all in one place, reply in minutes, and follow up automatically until each person says yes or no.

plain.h2: What you get, in plain terms.
plain.p: A CRM is one place where every enquiry and every customer is kept, with their full history. Automation is the work it does on its own: replies, reminders, follow-ups and review requests. We set up both, connect them to your website, your pages and your phone, and show your team how to use them.

choose.h2: How to choose a CRM and automation partner in Mauritius.

items.p: The right setup follows your sales process, not the other way round. Ask a partner to map how enquiries reach you before they suggest a tool.

items.h: Ask who sets it up and who supports it
items.p: A CRM nobody looks after goes stale in months. Find out who builds it, who fixes it and who answers your team's questions.
In Mauritius, many customers enquire on WhatsApp first. Make sure your CRM brings those conversations in with the rest.

items.h: Ask how your team will learn it
items.p: A system only works if your team uses it. Ask how they will be trained, and what happens when someone new joins.

fl.h2: The part that turns attention into sales.
fl.p: Your ads, website and social media bring people in. Your CRM and follow-up make sure each one gets an answer and a next step. In Fledge, they are built together, so you can see where every sale came from.

items.q: What is a CRM, in plain words?
items.a: One place where you keep every enquiry and every customer, with their messages, calls, quotes and history. Your whole team sees the same thing.
We build on GoHighLevel, which brings your inbox, pipeline, booking, email and automation into one place. If you already use a CRM, we look at it first and tell you honestly whether to keep it.
Yes. WhatsApp messages can land in the same inbox as everything else, and your team can get a WhatsApp alert for every new enquiry.

items.q: Will my customers know the replies are automatic?
items.a: The first reply tells them you have their message and what happens next. Real conversations stay with your team. If you want an assistant that answers questions too, see AI implementation.

items.q: Do I need to change how my team works?
items.a: A little, for the better. We build around how you already sell, then show your team the new way. Most of what it removes is copying, chasing and remembering.

items.q: How long does the setup take?
items.a: [About 2 to 3 weeks, to confirm.] It depends on how many channels and steps we connect.

items.q: Can you move our contacts from spreadsheets?
items.a: Yes. We bring your existing contacts and customers into the CRM, cleaned up, so your team starts with everything in one place.

items.q: Is this only for large businesses?
items.a: No. Small teams often gain the most, because every enquiry counts and nobody has time to chase them by hand.
